about: The one incident-scope contract shared by _shared/scope.mjs (Node) and _shared/gb2l_core.py (Python). Change it here only, and bump scope_schema when old scope files would no longer mean the same thing.

actions.read_public_github: Read public GitHub issues, runs and files (GET only)
actions.passive_lookup: Passive RDAP / DNS / certificate / archive lookups (queries public lookup services)
actions.save_local: Save incident reports, snapshots, baselines and packets inside the toolbox folder
actions.local_patch: Create a local copy of a project and prepare a patch (nothing pushed)
actions.run_project_tests: Run a project's tests locally with the network blocked
actions.live_http_inspection: Send requests to the organization's (or a redirect target's) live website
actions.third_party_submission: Submit a URL or file to a public scanning/reputation service
actions.external_write: Comment, open an issue/PR, fork, or commit anywhere outside this machine
actions.contact_third_party: Contact the organization, maintainer, registrar, host or anyone else

services.gmail: Google Gmail API (outgoing approved message and destination email address)
services.rdap: registration data services (rdap.org and domain registries)
services.dns: the DNS resolver (and, through it, the domain's own DNS servers)

optional.deny_actions: list of action names that are always refused for this scope, whatever permissions or attestations say. This is the executable form of 'prohibited'; the prohibited prose is guidance for people only.
optional.allow_derived_lookalikes: true lets lookalike_domain_check look up generated lookalike names of a listed target (each name is still disclosed to the allowed lookup services). Default false: only names listed in targets are looked up.
